description: Read live data from one of the user's connected accounts. what='reviews' (asc, play_console): the app's own reviews with reply status, unanswered=true for those without a developer reply; their review_id feeds propose_action review.reply (Play only returns reviews from the last 7 days). what='listing' (asc, play_console): the current listing text for one locale with lengths and which fields are editable right now (App Store name, subtitle, description, keywords and what's new need a version in Prepare for Submission). what='ads' (apple_ads): view=campaigns → ad_groups (campaign_id) → keywords (campaign_id, ad_group_id) gives the ids the ads.* actions take, view=negatives lists negative keywords, view=report with level=campaigns|adgroups|keywords|searchterms returns impressions, taps, installs, spend, CPT and CPA for start..end (default the last 7 days). Cost: 1 credits.

ad_group_id.description: ads: ad group id (needed for keywords; optional for negatives)

app.description: A linked app (App Store id or package name); required for reviews and listing

campaign_id.description: ads: campaign id (needed for ad_groups, keywords, negatives and every report level except campaigns)

country.description: reviews: App Store territory filter (two-letter code)

cursor.description: reviews: next_cursor from the previous page

end.description: ads report: end date YYYY-MM-DD (default yesterday, UTC)

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

full_text.description: Return long text (description, release notes, review bodies) in full instead of cut short

limit.description: Max rows: reviews up to 200 (default 100), ads up to 1000 (default 200)

locale.description: listing: locale such as en-US, de-DE (default en-US)

start.description: ads report: start date YYYY-MM-DD (default 7 days before end)

unanswered.description: reviews: only reviews without a developer reply

name: read_connection
title: Read Connection
